newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: EU agrees law to counter U.S. anti-Cuba moves.
newsitem.headline: EU agrees law to counter U.S. anti-Cuba moves.

text.p: European Union foreign ministers agreed a new law on Monday to counter U.S. anti-Cuba legislation, EU diplomats said.
Agreement came after the proposed law was amended to allow Denmark, which had threatened to veto it, to support the measure.
"It is agreed ... Helms-Burton is settled," said one diplomat, referring to the U.S law which threatens European companies and individuals with lawsuits if they trade with Cuba.
The EU law forbids European companies or individuals from complying with U.S. litigation and also allows them to countersue in Europe.
"Everyone is happy, the Danes have accepted a formula," said another diplomat.
Denmark had opposel on the grounds it compromised national sovereignty.
